question: Cubic has encouraging equal-node development scores but known inference cost. Can fewer active polynomial components retain prediction quality before implementing a cheaper inference path?
fit: First1024/source, equal-source full raw cross entropy, rank each of16 components by leave-one-out loss increase.
evaluation: Remaining1024/source, unchanged consumed development inputs and invalid-CP sensitivity. No reranking on evaluation half.
decision: A diagnostic only. Full16 must reproduce the averaged input. Do not claim speed from zeroed heads; any cheaper path needs separate correctness/cost and chess testing. No strength-based rank/window selection.
resources: One BelowNormal JVM, one active processor,768MiB, only after tournament batch boundary; no training or original-store writes.
